name: razgon-block-studio
description: Voiceover → 'What if <X> became <game>?' video in a 1M-view competitor's format. The world follows the topic: blocky avatars (Roblox-type), pixel cube sandbox (Minecraft-type) or cartoon battle royale (Fortnite-type). Giant 1–2-word captions, RULE cards, DAY counters, countdown rings, red-alarm / grey-death looks, VHS rewind transitions, game UI, comic SFX. Code-rendered, Whisper timestamps, 16:9 or 9:16 up to 4K.
